rows.evidence: The grinder may be coupled to the railhead only after the signalman posts the confirmation on the board.
rows.reason: Policy explicitly states a precedence relation where Event A (lockout confirmation) must occur before Event B (coupling the grinder).
The policy does not link lockout confirmation (Event A) to track circuit polling (Event B) in any explicit relation.
The policy does not link Event A (coupling the grinder) to Event B (polling track circuits).
